completion:
Record detailed fault descriptions, including issues such as spongy brakes or excessive brake wear.
3. Note the front and rear brake pads.
4. Attach records related to parking brake procedures.
5. Write the test results clearly in the inspection report.
6. Have the terminator and executor fill in their names and signatures.
7. Cross-check all records to ensure data integrity.
